name: opencode-vscode
description: A native-feeling GUI for OpenCode in VS Code, powered by the Agent Client Protocol (ACP). No terminals, no console output — just chat.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: OpenCode runs as a child process and can read and write files in the workspace.

opencode.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `opencode` executable. Leave as `opencode` to resolve it from `PATH`. Over SSH that `PATH` does not include the remote login shell's, so a bare name is resolved by asking the remote login shell instead; run `which opencode` in a VS Code terminal to get the absolute path it reports. On a remote host, set this in the *Remote [SSH: host]* scope.

opencode.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Extra arguments inserted before `acp`, e.g. `["--print-logs"]` to write agent logs to a file. Note that `--print-logs` makes the agent log to stderr, which this extension keeps out of your UI.

opencode.env.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables for the `opencode acp` child process.

opencode.configFile.markdownDescription: An extra OpenCode config file to load, for a provider that lives in one of its own rather than in `opencode.json`. OpenCode merges it into the config it would otherwise load. Handed to the agent as `OPENCODE_CONFIG`, and used for the settings this extension reads — the model list, the agents — so those match what the session can use. A leading `~` is expanded. Over SSH, set this in the *Remote [SSH: host]* scope, where the profile exporting `OPENCODE_CONFIG` itself is one the extension host never reads.

opencode.configDir.markdownDescription: An OpenCode config directory to use instead of the global `~/.config/opencode`, searched for agents, commands, modes and plugins exactly as that one is. Handed to the agent as `OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR`. A leading `~` is expanded. Note this *replaces* the global directory rather than adding to it; use `opencode.configFile` to add a file without changing where the rest comes from.

enumDescriptions: Ask me every time before a tool runs.
Approve read-only tools automatically, ask for edits and commands.
Approve everything automatically. Only use this in a trusted workspace.
opencode.permissions.description: How often OpenCode asks before running a tool.

enumDescriptions: Show file changes as an inline diff inside the chat.
Open changes in the native VS Code diff editor.
opencode.diffView.description: Where to preview file changes made by the agent.

opencode.showThoughts.description: Show the agent's reasoning stream in the chat. Off by default to keep the transcript tidy.

opencode.showPlan.description: Show the agent's execution plan as a checklist above the chat.

opencode.fontSize.markdownDescription: Font size in pixels for chat text. `0` uses the editor's default.

opencode.maxToolOutputLines.description: How many lines of tool output to show before collapsing the rest.

opencode.confirmDestructiveCommands.description: Show an extra confirmation for permission requests that run destructive shell commands.

opencode.reuseLastSession.markdownDescription: Reopen the previous chat automatically when VS Code starts. The agent replays the transcript from its own session store, so nothing is lost.

scripts.test: node esbuild.mjs && node --test dist/test/unit.test.js dist/test/startup.test.js dist/test/host-info.test.js && node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs
